description: Creates or changes one resource in the scene draft. `replace` writes the whole resource (read its type with scene_get first for the shape); `merge` changes only the fields given and keeps the rest. Send one of them. Where a scene_get answer says `value` or `edits`, that is `replace` and `merge` here. Viewers see changes after scene_publish.

basedOnVersionId.description: Optional safety check: the `revision` from scene_get or from the last scene_set answer for this path. With it the change is refused (CONFLICT) if the resource changed since. Omitted: writes over whatever is there.

merge.description: Only the fields to change, merged into the existing resource; null removes a field. E.g. {"props":{"value":"New headline"}} on frame/intro/headline keeps its position and style.

replace.description: The whole resource, shaped as scene_get returns it; a field left out is cleared. Creates the path when it does not exist.

name: scene_set
title: Change a scene's draft
